description: Every source behind this server with its kind (inbox, repository, docs, wiki, discord), item count, last update and freshness (fresh/stale): the 56 mailing lists, the git repositories, the documentation releases, the wiki and Discord. Use it to learn the inbox and repository names other tools accept and how current each is. kind filters; min_items drops small sources.

min_items.description: Only return sources with at least this many items

offset.description: Forward-compat: skip the first N rows

name: list_sources
